name: Auditoría SEO · Leads (Supabase → Airtable + Gmail) · cada 5 min

parameters.query:
update seo_audit.leads l set webhook_status = 'processing', claimed_at = now()
where l.id in (
  select id from seo_audit.leads
  where webhook_status in ('skipped', 'failed')
     or (webhook_status = 'processing' and claimed_at < now() - interval '30 minutes')
  order by created_at
  limit 20
  for update skip locked
)
returning l.id, l.created_at, l.name, l.email, l.company, l.audited_url, l.score, l.grade,
          l.fails, l.warnings, l.top_issues, l.marketing_consent, l.report_url;
